'''C86''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] in service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. On [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], C86 was part of a detachment sent to disable the defenses of a [[House Ulgo]] fortress, but the unit met heavy resistance and all except C86 were destroyed. Badly damaged, C86 asked an Imperial hero to avenge his fallen comrades and finish the mission before deactivating.<ref name="Vengeance" />
